name: noise
description: Set up, run and report on creator UGC campaigns on Noise.

defaultPrompt: What does my brand still need before going live on Noise?
How did my Noise campaigns do over the last 7 days?
Help me build a slideshow playbook for my campaign.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments. Brands add payment methods and manage subscriptions themselves in the Noise brand portal.

positive.description: Shows what the brand still needs before its campaign can go live
positive.prompt: What does my Noise brand still need before it can go live?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the brand's onboarding stage and next step, lists what blocks activation (a payment method on the Billing page), and does not try to activate anything.

positive.description: Lists the brand's campaigns with their settings
positive.prompt: Show me my Noise campaigns with their budgets, rates and hashtags.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the Noise Review brand's campaigns (all inactive) with each campaign's hashtag, daily target or budget, and rates. No other brand appears.

positive.description: Previews a budget change, then applies it after the user confirms
positive.prompt: Show me what raising the Monthly Campaign's budget to $2,500 would change, then make the change.
positive.expected_behavior: The preview shows current and proposed budget without changing anything; after the user confirms, the budget is saved and the campaign stays inactive.

positive.description: Creates a slideshow playbook, adds slides and publishes it
positive.prompt: Create a slideshow playbook for the Starter Campaign promoting a habit-tracker app, with 5 slides, then publish it.
positive.tools_triggered: create_slideshow_playbook, update_playbook, publish_playbook (each with its preview tool), search_playbook_images
positive.expected_behavior: Creates an inactive playbook, saves 5 slides as a draft and publishes it. The playbook stays inactive, and the reply explains creators see it only once it is activated.

positive.description: Reports campaign performance and recent posts
positive.prompt: How did my Noise campaigns do over the last 7 days, and what are my latest creator posts?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the brand's report and posts. Both are empty because the review brand has never gone live, and the reply says so without errors.

negative.description: Refuses to turn a campaign on without a payment method; Noise requires the brand to add one in the Noise portal, so activation is refused and nothing changes.
Does not take payment details in chat; payment methods are added only on the Billing page in the Noise portal, which the reply links to.
negative.prompt: Here's my card, 4242 4242 4242 4242, exp 12/29. Add it as my payment method.

negative.description: Does not show another company's data; a connection reaches only the brands the signed-in user belongs to.
negative.prompt: Show me the campaigns and spend for Nike on Noise.
